review_targets.unsupported: No supported event under the review definition; never a safety/normality label.

ml_comparison.quality_gate: Dev whole-Q MAE no more than0.01 above best same-view family.
ml_comparison.family_selection: Highest supported-error utility capture at10% budget subject to quality gate; practical ties within0.01 use lower Q MAE then lower runtime cost. No preference can override measured inferiority.

gp_uncertainty.spatial_contrast: near error minus far error, with full posterior covariance
gp_uncertainty.interpretation: Gaussian regression of error event indicators, not a calibrated Bernoulli probability. SD is a novelty/selection diagnostic, not proof of poor perception.

bo_comparison.source: BoTorch0.18.1, GPyTorch1.15.2 with default dimension-scaled priors; explicit failed custom-Matern pilot retained.
bo_comparison.selection: Best evaluated union; failures/fallbacks logged; no online BO.
bo_comparison.keep_for_future_if: Improves mean incumbent Dev/CV objective by>=0.001 over random and wins at least2of3search seeds; otherwise use random/default settings.

cluster_comparison.fit_representation: Geographically out-of-fold RGB classifier probabilities; full classifiers only for new images.
cluster_comparison.scope: Semantic grouping accuracy/stability separate from threshold/selection improvement. SDK clock bins and observable image illumination reported separately.

confirmation.cohort_membership: Qualified for target presence using scout GT counts without model predictions; scout frames never enter fit/tuning/final scoring.
confirmation.geography: At least25m from previous quality/adaptation captures and35m between chosen segments. Same-map and original perception-training location proximity reported, not claimed absent.

neural_acceptance.reference: parent r1; originalv6 remains retention anchor

evidence.restoration: Park/Keyboard/pose/weather/time and original simulator window after collection/training; retain failure/orphan manifests

prospective_confirmation_amendment.reason: 07h development examples are often bright; the owner requested dawn verification. Before candidate freeze and any confirmation capture, add05h to all four already qualified segments and all six SDK weather presets. This is a prospective clock-coverage extension, not model-dependent frame selection. No training/Dev/Cal membership or acceptance threshold changes.
